name: badge
summary: A short label or a count beside something else, such as Vegan or 3.

properties.name: text
properties.description: The words, which are what assistive technology reads.

properties.name: tone
properties.description: The colour role, from the theme.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Visual weight: solid fills with the tone, soft tints, outline draws only the edge.

states.name: rest
states.description: The tone and variant's colours. A badge is words, not a control, so it has no other state.

accessibility.name: Its words. Its icon is hidden.
accessibility.web: A <span> whose text is read with what it sits in.
accessibility.apple: Combined into one element with its words; never a button.
accessibility.windows: UI Automation ControlType.Text named by its words, not keyboard focusable.

cases.person: A green-tinted label that says Vegan.
A red filled count that says 3.

deviations: Also a button with onClick and a link with href, for filter chips and tags. Native kits use a small Button for a chip someone presses.
